### The Feast of Booths
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/feast-booths
Passage: Leviticus 23:33-43
Points:
- Celebrated at the close of the harvest, the Feast of Booths was a joyful time of thanksgiving for God's provision.
- Staying in temporary shelters reminded the Israelites of their wilderness journey and God's sustaining presence.
- Dwelling in booths guarded the people against pride and assuming their prosperity in Canaan came from self-reliance.
- Stepping away from home comforts illustrates the believer's need to abandon self-sufficiency and turn wholeheartedly to the Redeemer.
